  "ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER_ORIGIN".
- **Avoid:** "installation parameter" (banned, prose): write "deployment
  parameter".
- **Avoid:** "installation parameters" (banned, prose): write "deployment
  parameters".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#parameters), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters.

#### <a id="blueprint-deployment-fact-parameter"></a>deployment-fact parameter

A deployment parameter taking one deployment fact, named by `${{
deployment.creator.<fact> }}`.

- **Kind of:** [deployment parameter](#blueprint-deployment-parameter)
- **reads:** [deployment fact](#deployment-deployment-fact)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_UNKNOWN_DEPLOYMENT_FACT`,
  `ERR_DEPLOYMENT_FACT_UNAVAILABLE`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters.

#### <a id="blueprint-document-reference"></a>document reference

A node's componentRef naming the component document it deploys, either as an
item-local path or as a catalog identity with a revision.

- **Part of:** [node](#blueprint-node)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `componentRef`; codes: `ERR_COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND`,
  `ERR_REFERENCE_ESCAPE`, `ERR_INVALID_DEPENDENCY`; requirement prefixes:
  `BP-REF`
- **Not to be confused with:** A placeholder, `${{ }}`, which is never a
  reference.
- **Not to be confused with:** Blueprint §4.1's title, Component reference,
  which names the field rather than the term.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2
  §4.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#component-reference)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: composition.

#### <a id="blueprint-exposure"></a>exposure

A node's per-endpoint choice of who may reach the endpoint and what the platform
does in front of it: visibility, access, viewer identity, viewer claims and
access exemptions.

- **Part of:** [node](#blueprint-node)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `exposure`; codes: `ERR_ENDPOINT_NOT_PUBLIC`; defs:
  `BlueprintExposure`
- **Not to be confused with:** Compose expose, which only publishes a port to
  linked services.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#node-compute), [blueprint v2
  §4.5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#access)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: networking, access.

#### <a id="blueprint-generated-parameter"></a>generated parameter

A deployment parameter whose value the platform creates once per deployment as a
persisted random credential of a fixed byte length and encoding.

- **Kind of:** [deployment parameter](#blueprint-deployment-parameter)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `generator`, `byteLength`, `encoding`; values: `HEX`,
  `BASE64`, `BASE64URL`; defs: `BlueprintParameterGenerator`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters, sensitivity.

#### <a id="blueprint-granted"></a>granted

Said of a managed connection that already exists and is scoped to the
deployment, connection parameter and permitted service on acquisition.

- **Kind of:** [managed](#blueprint-managed)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections), [ADR
  0039](adr/0039-provenance-is-chosen-at-deployment.md)
- **Status:** approved, provisional. Tags: connections.

#### <a id="blueprint-hash-parameter"></a>hash parameter

A deployment parameter whose value is a persisted BCRYPT or ARGON2ID password
hash of a generated parameter, recomputed only when its source rotates.

- **Kind of:** [deployment parameter](#blueprint-deployment-parameter)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `hash`, `algorithm`; values: `BCRYPT`, `ARGON2ID`;
  codes: `ERR_INVALID_HASHED_PARAMETER`; defs: `BlueprintParameterHash`
- **Avoid:** "ERR_INVALID_HASH_SOURCE" (banned, identifier): write
  "ERR_INVALID_HASHED_PARAMETER".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters, sensitivity.

#### <a id="blueprint-item-revision"></a>item revision

The positive integer on a blueprint's metadata that counts publications of its
catalog item, and that no other item document carries.

- **Part of:** [blueprint](#blueprint-blueprint)
- **Not to be confused with:** A component revision, which counts one
  component's publications.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#identity)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: blueprint, versioning.

#### <a id="blueprint-item-local-reference"></a>item-local reference

A component reference written as a ./ or ../ path to a .yaml or .yml file whose
real path stays inside the item root, and which takes its revision from that
document.

- **Kind of:** [document reference](#blueprint-document-reference)
- **Avoid:** "repo-local" (banned, prose): write "item-local".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2
  §4.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#component-reference), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: composition.

#### <a id="blueprint-managed"></a>managed

Supplied and operated by Musher, as one selection kind is, whose offering
decides whether the connection is granted or provisioned.

- **Kind of:** [selection kind](#blueprint-selection-kind)
- **Avoid:** "managed database" (banned, prose): write "a database an external
  node stands for". Managed means only supplied and operated by Musher.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections), [ADR
  0039](adr/0039-provenance-is-chosen-at-deployment.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: connections.

#### <a id="blueprint-node"></a>node

A named use of one component inside a blueprint, together with the compute,
storage, exposure and bindings that this use gives it.

- **Part of:** [blueprint](#blueprint-blueprint)
- **deploys:** [component](#component-component)
- **receives values through:** [binding](#blueprint-binding)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `/spec/nodes`, `/spec/nodes/*`; codes:
  `ERR_UNKNOWN_NODE`, `ERR_NODE_REQUIRED`; requirement prefixes: `BP-NODE`;
  defs: `BlueprintNode`
- **Verbs:** place a node; bind a node's input; a node deploys a component
- **Example:** The web node deploys ./components/web.yaml on
  general.standard.small.
- **Not to be confused with:** Kubernetes and Nomad 'node' (a host machine);
  these specs say 'host' for that.
- **Avoid:** "components" (banned, identifier): write "nodes". A component is
  the definition a node deploys.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §4](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#node-graph), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: blueprint, composition.

#### <a id="blueprint-node-graph"></a>node graph

The set of a blueprint's nodes and the bindings between them, which at
publication holds at least one node.

- **Part of:** [blueprint](#blueprint-blueprint)
- **Identifiers:** requirement prefixes: `BP-GRAPH`
- **Avoid:** "component graph" (banned, prose): write "node graph".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §4](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#node-graph), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: composition.

#### <a id="blueprint-node-output-binding"></a>node output binding

A binding whose origin is a named output of another node, or of the same node
for a discovery dependency.

- **Kind of:** [binding](#blueprint-binding)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `node`, `output`; codes: `ERR_UNKNOWN_OUTPUT`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#bindings)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: values.

#### <a id="blueprint-open-access"></a>OPEN

The access value under which the platform forwards every request without signing
a viewer in.

- **Kind of:** [access](#blueprint-access)
- **Identifiers:** values: `OPEN`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §4.5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#access)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: access.

#### <a id="blueprint-optional-parameter"></a>optional parameter

A submitted parameter that a deployment can be created without, because it
carries a default or every input it binds is optional, which a deployment then
leaves absent.

- **Kind of:** [submitted parameter](#blueprint-submitted-parameter)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_PARAMETER_NOT_OFFERED`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources),
  [blueprint v2 §5.4](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#deploy-form)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters.

#### <a id="blueprint-organization-variable"></a>organization variable

A value an organization configures once under an exact dotted key, which an
environment may override and a variable parameter reads by identity and version.

- **Not to be confused with:** The customer glossary's 'shared variable', an
  admitted customer-facing synonym.
- **Not to be confused with:** An environment variable, which a workload reads.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters.

#### <a id="blueprint-origin"></a>origin

The provenance of a value, named by the key present in a binding, an output's
from or a parameter, and never spelled 'source'.

- **Verbs:** a binding names its origin
- **Avoid:** "supplier" (banned, prose): write "origin".
- **Avoid:** "value source" (banned, prose): write "origin".
- **Avoid:** "value sources" (banned, prose): write "origins".
- **Source:** [component v2 §1.1](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms), [blueprint
  v2 §4.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#bindings), [blueprint v2
  §5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#parameters), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: values.

#### <a id="blueprint-parameter-binding"></a>parameter binding

A binding whose origin is a deployment parameter, the only way a value from
outside the documents reaches a node.

- **Kind of:** [binding](#blueprint-binding)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `parameter`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#bindings)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: values.

#### <a id="blueprint-parameter-from"></a>parameter from

The member of a deployment parameter holding exactly one whole placeholder in
the variables, deployment or connections namespace.

- **Part of:** [deployment parameter](#blueprint-deployment-parameter)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters, placeholder.

#### <a id="blueprint-parameter-origin"></a>parameter origin

The way one deployment parameter's value is obtained, named by the keys present:
submitted, generated, hash, variable, deployment-fact or connection.

- **Kind of:** [origin](#blueprint-origin)
- **Part of:** [deployment parameter](#blueprint-deployment-parameter)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#parameters)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters.

#### <a id="blueprint-placement-constraint"></a>placement constraint

A requirement that narrows which hosts may serve a node's compute profile, such
as cpuDedication or acceleratorRuntimes, and never substitutes a profile or
grants a resource.

- **Part of:** [compute](#blueprint-compute)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `placement`, `cpuArchitectures`, `cpuDedication`,
  `minAcceleratorMemoryGiB`, `acceleratorRuntimes`, `acceleratorInterconnect`,
  `acceleratorSKUClass`, `networkClass`; values: `dedicated`, `shared`; codes:
  `ERR_PLACEMENT_UNSATISFIABLE`; defs: `BlueprintPlacement`
- **Not to be confused with:** Pinning a version or a digest: pin means only
  that.
- **Avoid:** "placement pin" (banned, prose): write "placement constraint".
- **Avoid:** "placement pins" (banned, prose): write "placement constraints".
- **Avoid:** "advanced constraint" (discouraged, prose): write "placement
  constraint".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2
  §4.4](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#placement-constraints), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: compute.

#### <a id="blueprint-provisioned"></a>provisioned

Said of a managed connection created at its first acquisition for the
deployment, reused across retry, redeploy and update, and released only when the
deployment is deleted.

- **Kind of:** [managed](#blueprint-managed)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections), [ADR
  0039](adr/0039-provenance-is-chosen-at-deployment.md)
- **Status:** approved, provisional. Tags: connections.

#### <a id="blueprint-restricted-access"></a>RESTRICTED

The access value under which only viewers who sign in and whom the deployment's
access policy admits reach the endpoint.

- **Kind of:** [access](#blueprint-access)
- **Identifiers:** values: `RESTRICTED`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#access), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: access.

#### <a id="blueprint-selection"></a>selection

The immutable, authorized record of which connection one deployment uses for one
connection parameter, with its identity, version, kind, credential and protocol
views.

- **Part of:** [deployment snapshot](#deployment-deployment-snapshot)
- **chooses:** [connection](#blueprint-connection)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND`, `ERR_CONNECTION_DENIED`,
  `ERR_CONNECTION_INCOMPATIBLE`
- **Avoid:** "source reference" (banned, prose): write "requested path".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: connections.

#### <a id="blueprint-selection-kind"></a>selection kind

Who supplies a selected connection: MANAGED, supplied and operated by Musher, or
USER, a complete set the deployer supplies.

- **Part of:** [selection](#blueprint-selection)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections), [ADR
  0039](adr/0039-provenance-is-chosen-at-deployment.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: connections.

#### <a id="blueprint-storage-class"></a>storage class

The token naming what kind of storage may serve a volume allocation, such as
local-nvme, from the catalog's versioned vocabulary.

- **Part of:** [volume allocation](#blueprint-volume-allocation)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `storageClass`
- **Not to be confused with:** A Kubernetes StorageClass, which is a provisioner
  configuration.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#node-compute)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: storage.

#### <a id="blueprint-submitted-parameter"></a>submitted parameter

A deployment parameter whose value the deployer submits, falling back to its
default, and the only kind a deploy form edits.

- **Kind of:** [deployment parameter](#blueprint-deployment-parameter)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_MISSING_PARAMETER_VALUE`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#parameters), [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters.

#### <a id="blueprint-user-selection"></a>USER selection

A selection kind under which the deployer supplies every member of the protocol,
never merged with a managed selection.

- **Kind of:** [selection kind](#blueprint-selection-kind)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: connections.

#### <a id="blueprint-value-binding"></a>value binding

A binding whose origin is a non-sensitive logical literal written in the
blueprint.

- **Kind of:** [binding](#blueprint-binding)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `value`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#bindings)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: values.

#### <a id="blueprint-value-dependency"></a>value dependency

The edge from a value to the value it is computed from, through a node binding
or an output that forwards an input, which together MUST form no cycle.

- **Part of:** [node graph](#blueprint-node-graph)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_VALUE_CYCLE`
- **Not to be confused with:** A discovery dependency on an allocated endpoint
  property, which may form a loop.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#bindings)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: composition, values.

#### <a id="blueprint-variable-parameter"></a>variable parameter

A deployment parameter taking one organization variable, named by `${{
variables.<path> }}`, as visible to the environment the deployment reads
variable values from.

- **Kind of:** [deployment parameter](#blueprint-deployment-parameter)
- **reads:** [organization variable](#blueprint-organization-variable)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_VARIABLE_NOT_AUTHORIZED`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: parameters.

#### <a id="blueprint-view"></a>view

The members of one protocol taken from a selection for one consumer, which MUST
satisfy the requested protocol, capabilities and input schemas.

- **Part of:** [selection](#blueprint-selection)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: connections.

#### <a id="blueprint-viewer"></a>viewer

A person reaching a PUBLIC endpoint through the platform's proxy, whom the
platform may sign in and identify to the workload.

- **Not to be confused with:** A deployer, who creates or changes the
  deployment.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §4.5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#access)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: access, viewer.

#### <a id="blueprint-viewer-claim"></a>viewer claim

A fact about the viewer released to the workload beside their identity, EMAIL or
NAME, never by default.

- **Part of:** [exposure](#blueprint-exposure)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `viewerClaims`; values: `EMAIL`, `NAME`
- **Not to be confused with:** An OIDC claim in general; only these two are
  released.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §4.5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#access)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: viewer.

#### <a id="blueprint-viewer-identity-mode"></a>viewer identity mode

How the workload behind a RESTRICTED endpoint learns who the viewer is: NONE, a
HEADER, a signed ASSERTION, or as an OIDC client.

- **Part of:** [exposure](#blueprint-exposure)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `viewerIdentity`; values: `HEADER`, `ASSERTION`,
  `OIDC`; codes: `ERR_VIEWER_IDENTITY_NOT_FORWARDED`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#access), [component v2
  §5.2](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#endpoints), [ADR
  0035](adr/0035-how-identity-and-credentials-reach-a-workload.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: viewer.

#### <a id="blueprint-visibility"></a>visibility

Whether an endpoint is reachable from outside the deployment, PUBLIC, or only by
the platform and sibling nodes, PRIVATE, the default.

- **Part of:** [exposure](#blueprint-exposure)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `visibility`; values: `PUBLIC`, `PRIVATE`
- **Example:** A PRIVATE endpoint is unreachable from another deployment,
  another organization or the public.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#node-compute), [blueprint v2
  §4.5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#access)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: networking, access.

#### <a id="blueprint-volume-allocation"></a>volume allocation

The storage a node gives one volume its component declares: a size at or above
the volume's minimum, and optionally a storage class and an IOPS floor.

- **Part of:** [node](#blueprint-node)
- **allocates:** [volume](#component-volume)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `sizeGiB`, `minIOPS`; codes:
  `ERR_INVALID_VOLUME_ALLOCATION`, `ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`,
  `ERR_VOLUME_TOO_LARGE`; defs: `BlueprintVolumeAllocation`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#node-compute)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: storage.

### Listing: how an item is presented

#### <a id="listing-category"></a>category

The one closed-vocabulary value a storefront shelves a listing under, which
grows by minor release and shrinks only in a new major version.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `category`; values: `AGENTS`, `AUTOMATION`,
  `COMMUNICATION`, `DATABASES`, `DEVELOPER_TOOLS`, `INFRASTRUCTURE`, `MEDIA`,
  `MODELS`, `NETWORKING`, `OBSERVABILITY`, `PRODUCTIVITY`, `SECURITY`, `STORAGE`
- **Not to be confused with:** A tag, whose vocabulary is open and which a
  listing may carry up to sixteen of.
- **Avoid:** "AI_ML" (banned, identifier): write "AGENTS or MODELS". Retired in
  v2: AGENTS for an agent or an agent builder, MODELS for anything else.
- **Avoid:** "GAMING" (banned, identifier): write "MEDIA". Retired in v2: a game
  is entertainment, which MEDIA holds.
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.2](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#migration),
  [listing v2 §4.2](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#vocabularies), [ADR
  0003](adr/0003-controlled-vocabulary-placement.md), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation, vocabulary.

#### <a id="listing-display-name"></a>display name

The item's title on the storefront, at most 200 characters.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `displayName`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §4](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#presentation)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation.

#### <a id="listing-getting-started"></a>getting started

The optional Markdown, at most 5 000 characters in the overview Markdown
profile, saying what a person does right after the deployment is running, and
never holding a value.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `gettingStarted`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [listing v2 §4](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#presentation), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, provisional. Tags: presentation.

#### <a id="listing-icon"></a>icon

The square media file, at least 256 pixels and at most 1 MiB, that stands for an
item on the storefront.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `icon`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §5](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#media), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: media.

#### <a id="listing-item-type"></a>item type

The listing field saying which shape of catalog item it presents, BLUEPRINT
exactly when the item root holds blueprint.yaml, otherwise COMPONENT.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `itemType`; codes: `ERR_ITEM_TYPE_MISMATCH`
- **Not to be confused with:** A document's kind.
- **Source:** [listing v2 §3](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#identity)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation, catalog.

#### <a id="listing-license"></a>license

The SPDX expression naming the listed software's licence, whose shape is
structural and whose identifiers are checked against the pinned SPDX list at
admission.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `license`; codes: `ERR_UNKNOWN_LICENSE`; requirement
  prefixes: `LIST-LICENSE`
- **Source:** [listing v2
  §4](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#presentation), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation.

#### <a id="listing-lifecycle-stage"></a>lifecycle stage

The listing's claim of maturity on the ordered scale EXPERIMENTAL, BETA, STABLE,
or the terminal SUNSET saying the item is going away.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `lifecycleStage`; values: `EXPERIMENTAL`, `BETA`,
  `STABLE`, `SUNSET`
- **Not to be confused with:** Backstage lifecycle (experimental, production,
  deprecated), a different scale.
- **Source:** [listing v2
  §4.2](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#vocabularies)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation, vocabulary.

#### <a id="listing-listing"></a>listing

The presentation-only document of a catalog item, how a storefront shows,
categorizes and lets people discover it, which never influences how anything
runs.

- **Kind of:** [Musher document](#core-musher-document)
- **Part of:** [catalog item](#catalog-catalog-item)
- **Identifiers:** requirement prefixes: `LIST-ITEM`, `LIST-PRES`; defs:
  `ListingSpec`, `ListingMetadata`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#scope)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation.

#### <a id="listing-listing-url"></a>listing URL

One absolute https, http or mailto address a listing links to: its homepage, its
source repository or its support channel.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `homepageURL`, `sourceRepositoryURL`, `supportURL`;
  requirement prefixes: `LIST-URL`
- **Avoid:** "sourceRepoURL" (banned, identifier): write "sourceRepositoryURL".
- **Source:** [listing v2
  §4](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#presentation), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation.

#### <a id="listing-media-path"></a>media path

A relative path to a file under media/ in the item root, with an image
extension, for an icon, a screenshot or an overview image, read by stat and
image headers and never decoded before admission.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_MEDIA_NOT_FOUND`, `ERR_PATH_ESCAPE`,
  `ERR_DUPLICATE_MEDIA_PATH`, `ERR_MEDIA_TOO_LARGE`, `ERR_MEDIA_DIMENSIONS`;
  requirement prefixes: `LIST-MEDIA`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [listing v2 §5](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#media), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation, media.

#### <a id="listing-overview"></a>overview

The Markdown body of a listing, at most 20 000 characters, in the Markdown
profile listing §4.1 states.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `overview`
- **Avoid:** "description" (banned, identifier): write "overview". listing
  spec.description.
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [listing v2 §4](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#presentation), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation.

#### <a id="listing-overview-image"></a>overview image

A Markdown image in a listing's overview or getting-started text, which is a
media path and is not part of the screenshot gallery.

- **Kind of:** [media path](#listing-media-path)
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [listing v2 §4.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#overview-markdown)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: media.

#### <a id="listing-overview-markdown-profile"></a>overview Markdown profile

CommonMark 0.31.2 narrowed to have no raw HTML, only https, http, mailto or
fragment link destinations, and only media-path images, which a renderer also
MUST NOT exceed.

- **Part of:** [overview](#listing-overview)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_RAW_HTML`, `ERR_DISALLOWED_SCHEME`,
  `ERR_IMAGE_NOT_LOCAL`; requirement prefixes: `LIST-MD`
- **Avoid:** "description markdown profile" (banned, prose): write "overview
  Markdown profile".
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [listing v2 §4.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#overview-markdown),
  [ADR 0004](adr/0004-listing-description-trust-boundary.md), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation, security.

#### <a id="listing-published-media-set"></a>published media set

The mapping from each media path of an item to the location a consumer serves
that file's bytes from after ingest.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [listing v2 §5.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#media-resolution)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: media, publication.

#### <a id="listing-screenshot"></a>screenshot

One media file of a listing's gallery, at most 5 MiB and 4096 pixels per side,
with an optional caption and a basename unique in the gallery.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `screenshots`, `file`, `caption`; defs:
  `ListingScreenshot`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §5](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#media), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: media.

#### <a id="listing-summary"></a>summary

The plain-text tagline of a listing, at most 280 characters, never rendered as
Markdown.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `summary`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §4](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#presentation)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation.

#### <a id="listing-tag"></a>tag

A lowercase kebab-case discovery key, at most sixteen and unique per listing,
whose vocabulary stays open.

- **Part of:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `tags`; requirement prefixes: `LIST-TAG`
- **Not to be confused with:** An OCI image tag.
- **Not to be confused with:** A release tag.
- **Source:** [listing v2 §4](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#presentation)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: presentation.

### Catalog: where items are published

#### <a id="catalog-blueprint-item"></a>blueprint item

A catalog item whose root holds blueprint.yaml and listing.yaml, and every
component document the blueprint's nodes reference.

- **Kind of:** [catalog item](#catalog-catalog-item)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_UNREFERENCED_COMPONENT`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#identity), [blueprint
  v2 §3.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#item-directory)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: catalog.

#### <a id="catalog-catalog"></a>catalog

The published collection of items, keyed by identity and revision, that a
component reference by UUID resolves against and a storefront browses.

- **Verbs:** publish to the catalog; the catalog holds an item
- **Not to be confused with:** An OCI registry, which holds images; a registry
  is never the catalog, and 'registry' stays legitimate for an OCI registry or a
  model registry.
- **Avoid:** "component registry" (discouraged, prose): write "catalog".
- **Avoid:** "the registry" (discouraged, prose): write "the catalog". Say
  catalog for the published collection; an OCI registry stays a registry.
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [core v2 §4.1](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#item-directory), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: catalog.

#### <a id="catalog-catalog-item"></a>catalog item

A directory the catalog publishes as one unit, holding its item documents and
component documents at one item root: a blueprint item or a component item.

- **Part of:** [catalog](#catalog-catalog)
- **Identifiers:** requirement prefixes: `CORE-ITEM`
- **Avoid:** "deployable thing" (banned, prose): write "catalog item".
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [core v2 §1.3](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#terms), [core v2
  §4.1](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#item-directory), [core v2
  §4.2](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#item-identity), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: catalog.

#### <a id="catalog-component-item"></a>component item

A catalog item whose root holds listing.yaml with itemType COMPONENT and exactly
one component document, and no blueprint.

- **Kind of:** [catalog item](#catalog-catalog-item)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_COMPONENT_COUNT`
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [listing v2 §3.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#item-directory), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: catalog.

#### <a id="catalog-publication"></a>publication

The act of admitting a document or an item into the catalog, after every
admission-phase obligation it carries has completed.

- **completes:** [admission phase](#core-admission-phase)
- **Verbs:** publish a component; a revision counts publications
- **Avoid:** "counts releases" (banned, prose): write "counts publications".
  Release means only a specification release.
- **Source:** [component v2
  §4](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#metadata), [blueprint v2
  §3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#identity)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: catalog, publication.

#### <a id="catalog-publication-obligation"></a>publication obligation

A requirement a document may leave unmet while it is being written and MUST meet
when it is published, checked in the admission phase and never offline.

- **Part of:** [publication](#catalog-publication)
- **Example:** A SERVICE without an endpoint validates, and fails the
  publication obligation ERR_ENDPOINT_REQUIRED.
- **Source:** [component v2 §5](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#workload)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: catalog, validation.

#### <a id="catalog-storefront"></a>storefront

The browsing interface that renders listings so that people can find, compare
and deploy catalog items.

- **renders:** [listing](#listing-listing)
- **Source:** [listing v2 §1.1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [listing v2 §1](../specifications/listing/v2/spec.md#scope), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: catalog, presentation.

### Deployment: what a blueprint becomes when it runs

#### <a id="deployment-acquisition"></a>acquisition

The authorized operation, separate from every validation phase, that obtains
external context such as a catalog component, an organization variable or a
connection selection.

- **supplies:** [resolution](#deployment-resolution)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#component-reference), [blueprint
  v2 §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-allocation"></a>allocation

The platform's assignment of a concrete resource to a deployment, an endpoint
address, an OIDC client registration or a volume, kept in the snapshot and
changed only by reallocation.

- **Part of:** [deployment snapshot](#deployment-deployment-snapshot)
- **Source:** [component v2
  §5.2](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#endpoints), [blueprint v2
  §4.5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#access)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-allocation-stage"></a>allocation stage

The resolution stage that selects compute, storage and exposure and allocates
endpoint addresses.

- **Kind of:** [stage](#deployment-resolution-stage)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-artifact-digest"></a>artifact digest

The SHA-256 digest of a component document's bytes as resolved, which with its
identity and revision fixes exactly what a node deployed.

- **Part of:** [resolution record](#deployment-resolution-record)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `digest`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §4.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#component-reference), [blueprint
  v2 §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-build-stage"></a>build stage

The resolution stage, after values, that builds each git or upload source from
its pinned content into an image digest, reading its build secrets from resolved
values.

- **Kind of:** [stage](#deployment-resolution-stage)
- **Source:** [core v2
  §6.4](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#resolution-stages), [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources), [ADR
  0040](adr/0040-source-and-build-recipe.md)
- **Status:** approved, provisional. Tags: resolution, build.

#### <a id="deployment-connections-stage"></a>connections stage

The resolution stage that acquires one selection per connection parameter.

- **Kind of:** [stage](#deployment-resolution-stage)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.3](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#connections)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution, connections.

#### <a id="deployment-creator"></a>creator

The deployer who created a deployment, whose identity, email and name are
captured once at creation as deployment facts.

- **Kind of:** [deployer](#deployment-deployer)
- **Not to be confused with:** Pelorus Installer, renamed Creator.
- **Avoid:** "deployment.installer" (banned, identifier): write
  "deployment.creator".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources),
  [ADR 0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: deployment.

#### <a id="deployment-deployer"></a>deployer

The person or principal who creates or changes a deployment, filling in its
deploy form.

- **Not to be confused with:** A viewer, who uses what a deployment serves.
- **Not to be confused with:** The creator, the deployer who created it, whose
  facts are captured once.
- **Avoid:** "installer" (banned, prose): write "deployer".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#parameters), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: deployment.

#### <a id="deployment-deployment"></a>deployment

One blueprint revision instantiated for an organization, with its parameters,
selections and allocations, which rollouts apply and which lives until it is
deleted.

- **instantiates:** [blueprint](#blueprint-blueprint)
- **Verbs:** deploy a blueprint; create a deployment; redeploy; update a
  deployment; delete a deployment
- **Not to be confused with:** A Kubernetes Deployment, which is one workload's
  replica set.
- **Not to be confused with:** A deployment environment in the engineering
  conventions.
- **Avoid:** "installation" (banned, prose and identifier): write "deployment".
- **Avoid:** "installations" (banned, prose): write "deployments".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#parameters), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: deployment.

#### <a id="deployment-deployment-fact"></a>deployment fact

A sensitive fact about a deployment's creator, deployment.creator.identity,
email or name, captured once at creation and kept in the deployment snapshot.

- **Part of:** [deployment snapshot](#deployment-deployment-snapshot)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: deployment, sensitivity.

#### <a id="deployment-deployment-snapshot"></a>deployment snapshot

The private, versioned state behind a resolution record: submitted values,
selected variables, deployment facts, credential references, endpoint
allocations and connection selections.

- **Part of:** [deployment](#deployment-deployment)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `deploymentSnapshot`
- **Avoid:** "installationSnapshot" (banned, identifier): write
  "deploymentSnapshot".
- **Avoid:** "installation snapshot" (banned, prose): write "deployment
  snapshot".
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources),
  [ADR 0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution, sensitivity.

#### <a id="deployment-environment-stage"></a>environment stage

The resolution stage that encodes each workload's inputs into its environment
variables.

- **Kind of:** [stage](#deployment-resolution-stage)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources), [component v2
  §5.3](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#env-vars)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-materialization"></a>materialization

The step that hands resolved values, secrets included, to the running workload
through private channels, after the snapshot is persisted.

- **follows:** [resolution](#deployment-resolution)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-parameters-stage"></a>parameters stage

The resolution stage that obtains submitted values, organization variables,
deployment facts and persisted generated values.

- **Kind of:** [stage](#deployment-resolution-stage)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-record-stage"></a>record stage

The last resolution stage, which persists the deployment snapshot and writes the
resolution record.

- **Kind of:** [stage](#deployment-resolution-stage)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-replica"></a>replica

One running copy of a node's workload; a non-shared volume is mounted into at
most one at a time.

- **Part of:** [deployment](#deployment-deployment)
- **Not to be confused with:** 'instance' in its general sense, such as a Cloud
  Foundry service instance or an instance of a JSON Schema; a running copy of a
  workload is a replica, and the platform glossary bans 'instance' for it.
- **Avoid:** "running instance" (banned, prose): write "replica".
- **Avoid:** "running instances" (banned, prose): write "replicas".
- **Source:** [component v2
  §5.5](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#volumes), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: deployment.

#### <a id="deployment-resolution"></a>resolution

The ordered process that turns a blueprint and its pinned dependencies into the
effective values of one deployment, before any workload starts, producing the
public record and the private snapshot.

- **Part of:** [deployment](#deployment-deployment)
- **Identifiers:** codes: `ERR_INVALID_RESOLUTION_CONTEXT`; requirement
  prefixes: `BP-RESOLVE`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: deployment, resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-resolution-record"></a>resolution record

The generated, public JSON artifact pinning what one resolution chose, blueprint
digest, specification releases, nodes, artifacts, compute, variables and
credential references, with no secret in it.

- **Part of:** [resolution](#deployment-resolution)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `blueprintDigest`, `imageDigest`, `gitCommit`,
  `uploadDigest`, `recipeDigest`, `builderDigest`, `credentials`, `rotation`,
  `variables`, `/version`; defs: `BlueprintResolutionRecord`,
  `BlueprintResolvedNode`, `BlueprintResolvedComponent`,
  `BlueprintResolvedCredential`
- **Not to be confused with:** A Terraform state file, which holds secrets; this
  never does.
- **Source:** [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms),
  [blueprint v2 §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-rollout"></a>rollout

One applied generation of a deployment: the workloads started from one
resolution record, at creation, at each update and at each redeploy, during
which each unscheduled JOB runs once.

- **Part of:** [deployment](#deployment-deployment)
- **Not to be confused with:** Pelorus Release, the same concept.
- **Source:** [component v2 §5.7](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#jobs),
  [blueprint v2 §1.1](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#terms), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: deployment.

#### <a id="deployment-sources-stage"></a>sources stage

The first resolution stage, which pins content without building it: a git ref to
a commit, an upload to its verified digest, and a tag-only image or a buildpacks
builder to an image digest.

- **Kind of:** [stage](#deployment-resolution-stage)
- **Source:** [core v2
  §6.4](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#resolution-stages), [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources), [ADR
  0040](adr/0040-source-and-build-recipe.md)
- **Status:** approved, provisional. Tags: resolution, build.

#### <a id="deployment-specification-releases"></a>specification releases

The map in a resolution record naming the exact release of each family a
resolution was performed against: core, component and blueprint.

- **Part of:** [resolution record](#deployment-resolution-record)
- **Identifiers:** fields: `specifications`, `core`, `component`, `blueprint`;
  defs: `BlueprintResolvedSpecifications`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution, versioning.

#### <a id="deployment-resolution-stage"></a>stage

One step of resolution, in order sources, parameters, allocation, connections,
values, build, environment and record, that a resolution-phase diagnostic names.

- **Part of:** [resolution](#deployment-resolution)
- **Not to be confused with:** A validation phase; stage means only a resolution
  step, and is written 'resolution stage' where the context does not say so.
- **Source:** [core v2 §1.3](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#terms), [core v2
  §6.4](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#resolution-stages), [core v2
  §7](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#diagnostics), [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-values-stage"></a>values stage

The resolution stage that evaluates value dependencies and validates every input
and output against its value schema.

- **Kind of:** [stage](#deployment-resolution-stage)
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

#### <a id="deployment-versioned-identity"></a>versioned identity

An opaque identity paired with an immutable version, the way a record names a
variable, a snapshot or an allocation it does not contain.

- **Identifiers:** fields: `identity`, `version`; defs:
  `BlueprintVersionedIdentity`
- **Source:** [blueprint v2
  §5.2](../specifications/blueprint/v2/spec.md#value-sources)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: resolution.

### Repository: how the specifications are made

#### <a id="repository-behaviour-suite"></a>behaviour suite

A named group of behavioural cases, normalization, resolution, rendering or
lifecycle, that an implementation claims in addition to a validation scope.

- **Part of:** [conformance corpus](#repository-conformance-corpus)
- **Avoid:** "behavioural profile" (banned, prose): write "behaviour suite".
- **Avoid:** "behaviour profile" (banned, prose): write "behaviour suite".
- **Source:** [docs/conformance.md](conformance.md), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: conformance.

#### <a id="repository-conformance-case"></a>conformance case

One fixture of a family version's corpus: a document or behaviour, the phase it
reaches, the requirements it pins and the outcome an implementation MUST
produce.

- **Part of:** [conformance corpus](#repository-conformance-corpus)
- **Source:** [docs/conformance.md](conformance.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: conformance.

#### <a id="repository-conformance-corpus"></a>conformance corpus

The set of every case a family version ships under conformance/, which a
conforming implementation runs in its own CI together with the core corpus of
the core release it records.

- **Source:** [core v2 §8](../specifications/core/v2/spec.md#conformance),
  [docs/conformance.md](conformance.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: conformance.

#### <a id="repository-not-supported"></a>not supported in v2

The table closing each specification that lists what a document cannot yet
declare, each row with how it would close, and every closure a relaxation.

- **Avoid:** "unsupported capabilities" (banned, prose): write "not supported in
  v2".
- **Avoid:** "known debt" (banned, prose): write "not supported in v2".
- **Source:** [ADR 0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: repository, versioning.

#### <a id="repository-privilege"></a>privilege

A permission a runtime grants a workload beyond the ordinary, such as binding a
port below 1024, which admission may refuse.

- **Not to be confused with:** A connection capability such as STREAMING.
- **Source:** [component v2
  §5.2](../specifications/component/v2/spec.md#endpoints), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: security.

#### <a id="repository-release"></a>release

One tagged, immutable version of one family, X.Y.Z on the family's tag line,
recorded in the ledger and served from immutable GitHub assets.

- **Verbs:** release a family; a release records its core release
- **Not to be confused with:** A publication to the catalog, which these specs
  never call a release.
- **Not to be confused with:** Pelorus Release, which is a rollout.
- **Source:** [docs/publication.md](publication.md), [ADR
  0006](adr/0006-publication-from-tags.md), [ADR
  0023](adr/0023-published-bytes-are-immutable-release-assets.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: publication, versioning.

#### <a id="repository-requirement-id"></a>requirement ID

The stable anchor of one rule a document or an implementation can violate,
PREFIX-AREA-NNN such as COMP-EP-004, which conformance cases cite.

- **Source:** [docs/conformance.md](conformance.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: conformance.

#### <a id="repository-specification"></a>specification

The normative spec.md of one family version, the definitive statement of its
rules, beside which schemas, examples and generated pages are informative.

- **defines:** [family](#core-family)
- **Source:** [docs/conventions.md](conventions.md)
- **Status:** approved, stable. Tags: repository.

#### <a id="repository-term-record"></a>term record

One entry of docs/terminology.yaml naming a concept in one context, with its
definition, relations, identifiers and the words to avoid in its place.

- **Not to be confused with:** A catalog token, formerly called a term.
- **Source:** [docs/terminology.md](terminology.md), [ADR
  0038](adr/0038-v2-one-vocabulary-and-v1-retires.md)
- **Status:** approved, provisional. Tags: repository.

## Words we avoid

A banned prose alias is a Vale error and a discouraged one a warning. An
identifier alias is checked by `task check:terms` against the schema sources and
the diagnostics tables of the families its record belongs to.

| Avoid | Status | Scope | Write instead | Term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| accessExemptions | banned | identifier | exemptibleRequests | [exemptible requests](#component-exemptible-requests) |
| address family | banned | prose | URL-addressed or port-addressed | [URL-addressed](#component-url-addressed) |
| address property | banned | prose | endpoint property | [endpoint property](#component-endpoint-property) |
| admits a namespace | banned | prose | permits a namespace | [namespace](#core-placeholder-namespace) |
| advanced constraint | discouraged | prose | placement constraint | [placement constraint](#blueprint-placement-constraint) |
| AI_ML | banned | identifier | AGENTS or MODELS | [category](#listing-category) |
| atomic connection | banned | prose | connection | [connection](#blueprint-connection) |
| atomic connections | banned | prose | connections | [connection](#blueprint-connection) |
| AUTHENTICATED | banned | identifier | RESTRICTED | [access](#blueprint-access) |
| behaviour profile | banned | prose | behaviour suite | [behaviour suite](#repository-behaviour-suite) |
| behavioural profile | banned | prose | behaviour suite | [behaviour suite](#repository-behaviour-suite) |
| BP-CONN | banned | identifier | BP-BIND | [binding](#blueprint-binding) |
| capability | banned | identifier | admission | [admission phase](#core-admission-phase) |
| capability check | banned | prose | admission check | [admission phase](#core-admission-phase) |
| capability checks | banned | prose | admission checks | [admission phase](#core-admission-phase) |
| capability phase | banned | prose | admission phase | [admission phase](#core-admission-phase) |
| COMP-REF | banned | identifier | COMP-PLACEHOLDER | [placeholder](#core-placeholder) |
| compatibility family | banned | prose | major version | [major version](#core-major-version) |
| component graph | banned | prose | node graph | [node graph](#blueprint-node-graph) |
| component registry | discouraged | prose | catalog | [catalog](#catalog-catalog) |
| ComponentEndpointAccessExemptions | banned | identifier | ComponentEndpointExemptibleRequests | [exemptible requests](#component-exemptible-requests) |
| components | banned | identifier | nodes | [node](#blueprint-node) |
| composition time | discouraged | prose | the blueprint | [blueprint](#blueprint-blueprint) |
| configuration contract | banned | prose | component contract | [component contract](#component-component-contract) |
